title: Inner products as areas
caption: With ⟨f, g⟩ = ∫₀¹ f g dx, the inner product is an area: ⟨x, x²⟩ is the area under x³, which is ¼, and ‖x‖² = ⟨x, x⟩ is the area under x², which is ⅓, so ‖x‖ = 1/√3 ≈ 0.577.
alt: Graphs of y = x³ and y = x² between 0 and 1, with the area under x³ shaded (¼) and the larger area under x² (⅓).
description: The curve y = x² is the product x · x; the area under it from 0 to 1 is ⅓, so ‖x‖² = ⅓.
The curve y = x³ is the product x · x²; the area under it is ¼, so ⟨x, x²⟩ = ¼.
